List.Title: Scene emitters
List.Empty: No emitter on this scene. Use the "Place an emitter" tool.

Engine.Name: Rendering engine
Engine.Hint: Ember (recommended): the module's own engine, with height, wind, blow-out, adaptive light and world reactions. Foundry: the generator built into Foundry v14, experimental and limited. Applies to every player.

Performance.Name: Particle quality
Performance.Hint: Reduces how many particles are drawn on this computer. Useful for modest machines.

Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can edit emitters.
Error.NoParticleApi: Ember: Foundry's particle generator was not found. Ember requires Foundry VTT v14.

Wind.Title: Scene wind
Wind.Hint: Pushes every effect on the scene. Each effect reacts its own way: smoke and leaves blow away, fire barely bends, magic ignores it.

WindBehavior.campfire: flares up: more, taller, brighter flames
WindBehavior.torch: brightens and flickers, goes out in a storm and relights afterwards
WindBehavior.candle: flickers, goes out in a draft and relights when it dies down
WindBehavior.bonfire: flares up; more embers and sparks torn away, the smoke lies down
WindBehavior.forge: flares up and spits more sparks
WindBehavior.cauldron: the fire flares up, the steam clears
WindBehavior.ritual: the magic ignores the wind, but the candles can blow out
WindBehavior.swamp: the mist scatters, the fireflies hide

Light.Title: Light
Light.AutoNone: Ember light (this effect gives no light)
Light.LinkHint: Sorted from nearest to farthest from the emitter, with bright/dim radii. It goes out, flickers and flares with the flame; its document is never changed.
Light.VisionHint: Checked: a real Foundry light that counts for vision (a blown-out flame plunges the area into darkness). Unchecked: a visual glow only, with no effect on what tokens see.
Light.Follows: The light follows the flame: off when blown out, stronger when the wind stokes it, dipping when it flickers.
Light.EmberOnly: Adaptive light only works with the Ember engine (module settings).

Engine.ActiveWarning: Ember is using Foundry's particle generator: height, live wind, flame blow-out, adaptive light and world reactions are disabled. Switch back to the Ember engine in the module settings.
Engine.Note: Foundry's generator is experimental and only supports part of Ember's effects.
Engine.WarnIntro: The particle generator built into Foundry v14 is experimental. With it, emitters lose:

Lose.Height: height and perspective (rising, falling, top-down view)
Lose.Wind: live wind, gusts and wind reactions (frozen at creation only)
Lose.World: world reactions: walls, tokens and darkness

Engine.WarnOutro: This applies to every player. You can switch back to the Ember engine at any time.

World.Title: World reactions
World.WallsHint: Particles stay in the room and only leave through open doors.
World.WallsMagic: This effect is magical: it passes through walls.
World.TokensHint: Visible tokens passing by push particles away and leave a wake.
World.DarknessHint: The effect changes with the scene's darkness.
World.DarknessNight: Only appears in darkness: invisible on a daylight scene. Uncheck to show it at any time.
World.EmberOnly: World reactions only work with the Ember engine.

Layers.Title: Group layers
Layers.Hint: Uncheck an effect to remove it from the group, or change its density. The emitter's size, density and radius apply to every layer.
Layers.LeadHint: Main layer: it carries the group's light and blowout.
